answer: Attest inside a hardware TEE. Seal the measurement into a quote. Have three peers verify it. Dilute credit when they disagree and bleed standing from identities that go idle. Each clone then needs its own enclave, so 100 fakes cost 100 devices instead of 100 API keys. The smaller mechanism wins: no token sale, no auction, just a signed quote where a fable of uptime used to be. Shale is cheap, a sealed measurement is not, and the pigment of a farm fades as its idle accounts lose standing.
